notes.title: Team cards show size, spread and visibility at a glance
notes.body:
Cards are the default layout for Teams.

- Each card shows the name, the description (two lines, then truncated), members, the admin groups its members span, and pending invites.
- The footer shows portal users with access as avatars, or a **Not visible to anyone** flag with a **Give access** link.
- Empty teams have a dashed border, "No members yet" and an **Add students** link.
- The whole card opens the team page. The checkbox and ⋮ menu appear on hover or keyboard focus, and stay visible while anything is selected.
notes.author: Matt

notes.title: Cards and rows toggle, remembered per person
notes.body:
Switches the Teams list between cards and a table.

- The choice is saved in the browser (`localStorage` key `sans-teams-layout`) and restored on the next visit.
- Search, filters, sort and selection work the same in both layouts.
- In rows, clicking a row or pressing Enter on it opens the team.
notes.author: Matt

notes.title: Team health strip
notes.body:
Three tiles above the list, recalculated live.

- **Students in no team** opens Students with the "No team" filter applied.
- **Empty teams** and **Not visible to anyone** turn on the matching filter. Clicking again turns it off.
- When nothing needs attention, a tile shows a calm green state instead of disappearing, so the layout doesn't jump.
notes.author: Matt

notes.title: Search, quick filters and sort
notes.body:
- Search matches team name and description.
- Quick filters: All, Empty, Not visible to anyone, each with a live count.
- Sort: Name A to Z (default), Most members, Recently changed (the latest activity event for the team).
notes.author: Matt

notes.title: Team page with Members, Access and History tabs
notes.body:
Opening a team replaces the old pop-up with a full page.

- The header shows the description, who created the team and when it last changed. If there's no description, admins see an **Add a description** link.
- Tabs: Members, Portal users with access, History. Counts sit in the tab labels.
- **View training progress** is a placeholder. In the full product it opens Learning filtered to this team.
- ⋮ holds Edit details and Delete team.
notes.author: Matt

notes.title: Member bulk actions with Undo
notes.body:
Members use the shared bulk bar from Students.

- **Move to another team** opens a searchable picker, with "Create a new team" at the bottom.
- **Set admin group** only offers groups covered by the selected students' vouchers. Others are skipped, with a reason.
- **Remove from team** keeps them as students in the organisation.
- Every action applies straight away with **Undo** in the toast (about 10 seconds). Skipped rows are listed under **Details**.
- The same actions are in each row's ⋮ menu. Clicking a row opens the profile, which offers "Back to [team]".
notes.author: Matt

notes.title: Add students side panel
notes.body:
One panel for adding people to a team, opened from the team page, an empty team card, or straight after creating a team.

- **Choose students**: search, filter by current team, admin group and voucher, and "Select all N matching". People already in the team are shown but disabled. Anyone in another team gets a **Moves** tag.
- The footer summarises the effect before you commit, for example "3 will move from other teams · 1 has no team yet".
- **Paste emails** accepts commas, semicolons or new lines and sorts entries into found, already in this team, not a student yet, and not an email.
- Emails that aren't students yet go to the CSV review with the Team column filled in.
- **Upload a CSV** opens the CSV import.
- Focus is trapped while open, Esc closes it, and focus returns to the button that opened it.
notes.author: Matt

notes.title: Deleting a team moves its members instead of blocking
notes.body:
- If the team has members, the dialog asks where they go: move them to another team, or leave them with no team. The confirm button says what will happen, for example "Move 5 and delete".
- It names the portal users who will lose access (the first two, then "and N others").
- The team's history stays in the activity log.
- Bulk delete on the list only deletes empty teams. Teams with members are kept, with the reason given.
notes.author: Matt

notes.title: New team activity events and permissions
notes.body:
- New events: `team.renamed`, `team.description_changed` and `team.deleted`, alongside the existing `team.created`. They appear on the Activity page and in each team's History tab.
- New store commands: `updateTeam(id, { name, description })` and `deleteTeam(id)`. `createTeam(name, description)` now takes an optional description.
- Only Admins, SSO Admins and Limited Admins can change teams. Viewers see everything read-only, with no create, edit or delete controls.
- A team can only be deleted once it has no members. Portal users lose access to it automatically.
notes.author: Matt

notes.title: Demo data: team descriptions and varied team access
notes.body:
Reset the demo data to see these.

- Two new teams: Threat Intelligence (with a description) and Forensics Lab (without one). Both are empty.
- The original four teams have descriptions.
- Portal users now have access to different teams rather than all of them, so GRC & Audit starts out not visible to anyone.
notes.author: Matt
